dataItem-lwzdnx24.text: This tool enables customization of the IIT Machinery Hall's appearance through top-level controls located within the 'Building' node. I have separated my building into three parts: Base, Middle, and Top. The middle section is designed to allow for an increase in the number of floors.

dataItem-lwzdtfnh.text: I used Houdini respectively to make the building in those two projects.
